title: WanChai Connection
native_title: ワンチャイ コネクション
overview:
A woman wanders the streets of Hong Kong in search of her lost memories.
Can Michael Lee (you) unravel all the mysteries!?

Hong Kong, 1997. A woman washes ashore injured and without her memory, and Michael Lee, a skilled detective of the Hong Kong police, takes the case. As he digs for the truth hidden in her fragmented memories, he is drawn into further incidents.

This detective adventure is told through live-action video with fully voiced dialogue, starring Toshikazu Fukawa, Aya Sugimoto and Daijiro Harada. Question witnesses to uncover key information that opens new lines of inquiry, and examine evidence and move between locations on a 3D investigation screen. An easy mode shows what information is still waiting to be found.

- 1 player
- Two discs
- Memory backup support

マイケル李(あなた)はすべての謎を解き明かすことができるか!?
